# Fundação Calouste Gulbenkian

> > The Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation is a Portuguese philanthropic institution supporting arts, culture, education, science, and social development across Portugal and Portuguese-speaking countries.

The Foundation operates major cultural venues including the Gulbenkian Museum, supports scientific research through CISA, funds social innovation and entrepreneurship programs, and manages EEA Grants for civil society development. It also maintains the Gulbenkian Orchestra and promotes education initiatives from basic to postgraduate levels.

## Key Topics

- Fundação Calouste Gulbenkian

## Health and Medical Research

- [Um Novo Pacto para a Saúde](https://gulbenkian.pt/noticias/ministerio-da-saude-fundacao-gulbenkian-assinam-protocolo-promocao-da-saude-copy): New health pact report on Portuguese National Health Service reform
- [Campanha NÃO à diabetes!](https://gulbenkian.pt/noticias/campanha-nao-a-diabetes): National diabetes prevention campaign with municipalities and pharmacies
- [Hemoglobinopatias em investigação no CISA](https://gulbenkian.pt/noticias/hemoglobinopatias-em-investigacao-no-cisa): CISA research on hemoglobinopathies and genetic diseases in Angola

## Arts, Culture and Museum

- [Gallery of 19th-century painting and sculpture reopened](https://gulbenkian.pt/en/news/gulbenkian-museum/gallery-of-19th-century-painting-and-sculpture-reopened): Gulbenkian Museum reopens 19th-century gallery with Barbizon works
- [Emily Wardill. Matt Black and Rat](https://gulbenkian.pt/en/news/gulbenkian-museum/emily-wardill-matt-black-and-rat): Emily Wardill film installation at Gulbenkian Museum Project Space
- [Eu não evoluo, viajo.](https://gulbenkian.pt/noticias/eu-nao-evoluo-viajo): José Escada retrospective exhibition of abstract art and reliefs
- [Os universalistas chegam a Paris](https://gulbenkian.pt/noticias/os-universalistas-chegam-paris): Portuguese universalist architects exhibition featuring Siza in Paris

## Music and Performing Arts

- [Gulbenkian Música](https://gulbenkian.pt/noticias/sem-categoria/gulbenkian-musica-regressa-em-setembro): Gulbenkian Music season returns featuring Gustavo Dudamel orchestra
- [Orquestra Estágio Gulbenkian](https://gulbenkian.pt/noticias/orquestra-estagio-gulbenkian): Gulbenkian Internship Orchestra national tour with Joana Carneiro

## Social Innovation and Entrepreneurship

- [Manual for Changing the World](https://gulbenkian.pt/en/news/manual-for-changing-the-world-2): Social entrepreneurship manual publication by Institute in Portugal
- [Um momento de viragem para o investimento social](https://gulbenkian.pt/noticias/um-momento-de-viragem-para-o-investimento-social): Social investment turning point: G8 meeting and impact bonds discussion
- [Concurso Ideias de Origem Portuguesa 2016](https://gulbenkian.pt/noticias/concurso-ideias-origem-portuguesa-2016): 2016 Portuguese diaspora social entrepreneurship competition finalists
- [Vencedores Apps for Good 2015/2016](https://gulbenkian.pt/noticias/vencedores-apps-for-good-20152016): Apps for Good 2015/2016 winners announced for student mobile apps

## Education and Youth Development

- [First Master's Degree in Mathematics in Guinea Bissau](https://gulbenkian.pt/en/news/jardim-de-verao-2017): First mathematics master's degree launched in Guinea Bissau for teachers
- [Compass - Manual for human rights education with young people](https://gulbenkian.pt/en/news/compass-manual-for-human-rights-education-with-young-people): Compass manual Portuguese translation for youth human rights education
- [Where does so much evil come from?](https://gulbenkian.pt/en/news/where-does-so-much-evil-come-from): Conference on tolerance education and combating intolerance in schools
- [Cerimónia de entrega do Prémio Branquinho da Fonseca Expresso/Gulbenkian](https://gulbenkian.pt/noticias/cerimonia-de-entrega-do-premio-branquinho-da-fonseca-expressogulbenkian): Branquinho da Fonseca Prize ceremony for children's literature winner

## International Development
